children: The cost of Italy's public debt is rising at an alarming rate in the wake of geopolitical tensions, Economy Minister Giancarlo Giorgetti said on Friday.
Inflation is bound to rise if the wars in Ukraine and the Middle East continue, Giorgetti added, speaking via video link at a conference in Portofino.
